FN-TBRY855-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 156
Committee: Health Sponsor: Representative Paul Lee
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 01/20/2026
REVISED
House Bill 156 as introduced would allow the Alabama Board of Medical Examiners to join the
Physician Assistant (PA) Licensure Compact. The provisions of this bill: (1) would increase the
financial obligations of the Board by an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of the
annual assessment fee levied by the PA Licensure Compact Commission on each member state
to cover the costs of its operations, activities, staff, and annual budget as authorized in the
compact; (2) could decrease the amount of license fees currently collected from licensed
physician assistants with out-of-state residences who decide to become licensed in their home
state and practice in Alabama under the compact privilege by $44,000 annually; and (3) would
increase receipts to the Board from fees imposed for the multistate license by an undetermined
amount dependent upon the number of licenses issued and the fee amounts set by the Board.
Further, this bill would increase the administrative obligations of the Board to submit
information to the commission's licensure data system as provided for by the provisions of this
bill.
